prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in a bright modern rooftop terrace with a pale deck floor, a waist-high glass railing, a standard door and a city skyline in the daylight haze, bright and evenly lit with crisp defined shadows, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, empty of any people other than the subjects, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as them, NO dark background NO black void, TWO people standing side by side with generous spacing so every figure reads clearly and nobody's arms cross a neighbour, the camera set back so both are visible from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, under hard direct flash lighting, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

LEFT: ONE real adult Spanish person with a handsome man's face on a full, curvaceous female body — a man in his mid 20s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, an elegant handsome young male face with a high nose bridge, a defined jaw, straight brows and a strong neck, a very faint trace of stubble, natural idol makeup with soft brown eyeshadow and a tinted lip, smooth warm olive skin, a soft amused smile, soft rose-gold hair styled in vintage victory rolls framing the face, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a large platinum hoop carrying two heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on platinum chains of different lengths (a gold ship's anchor, a lead square-sided cowbell), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and on the other ear a large gold hoop carrying four heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on gold chains of different lengths (a gold miniature anvil, an iron ship's anchor, a silver pyramid-shaped lump, a tin small flared temple bell), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and a single rose-gold bracelet. Extremely long oval nails, chrome finish studded with crystals.
LEFT Physique: an extraordinarily tall and enormous woman, far beyond any real person, towering and broad; a commanding, statuesque frame with huge broad shoulders, powerful thick arms with hard defined muscle, a strong deep chest, and a long, dense, muscular torso with only a slight inward taper at the waist; enormous powerful hips and colossal long thighs with hard muscle visible through a soft layer, thick strong calves; not slim, not delicate, powerful, statuesque and imposing; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
LEFT Body Art: Her bare skin is painted in Peruvian Nazca painted pattern (a deep terracotta ground densely painted with stylised gold figures), wide gold bands following every deep crease and curving around the hips and thighs like contour lines, dense stepped geometric borders filling the space between every band. The paint is pigment sitting on living skin, so it distorts slightly over every bulge. The paint covers her whole body with no bare skin left anywhere below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of her hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of her feet. Her face is left unpainted and the pattern fades out at the neck with no hard line.
LEFT Pose: both hands on her hips, elbows out.
LEFT Footwear: Extreme cobalt-blue platform lace-up sandals, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

RIGHT: ONE real adult Kenyan man in his mid 20s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a pretty androgynous idol face with large doe eyes, a small chin and a soft jaw, clean-shaven, deep plum smoky eyes with dark lashes, deep ebony skin with a soft glow, a shy sweet smile, deep burgundy wine-red hair styled in wavy, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a single long silver chain ending in one large faceted sapphire drop, and on the other ear a large rose-gold hoop carrying three heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on rose-gold chains of different lengths (a gold round bell, a gold cube-shaped block, a lead square-sided cowbell), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and an extreme maximalist stack of well over ten silver necklaces. Extremely long stiletto nails, glitter finish studded with crystals.
RIGHT Physique: An extraordinarily large and muscular man, far beyond any real person, built like a muscle model. Wide broad shoulders, a full thick defined chest, large rounded arms with clear biceps and triceps, a hard defined abdomen on a trim waist, wide flaring lats, and strong muscular thighs and calves in balance with the upper body. Powerful and imposing, yet lean and polished. His head stays in correct proportion to his broad frame. His arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
RIGHT Body Art: His bare skin is painted in Mexican Talavera ceramic (a glossy white tin glaze with cobalt blue and marigold medallions), wide cobalt bands following every deep crease and curving around the hips and thighs like contour lines, dense medallion scrollwork filling the space between every band. The paint is pigment sitting on living skin, so it distorts slightly over every muscle and bulge. The paint covers his whole body with no bare skin left anywhere below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of his hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of his feet. His face is left unpainted and the pattern fades out at the neck with no hard line.
RIGHT Pose: square to camera, feet wide, arms clear of his body.
RIGHT Footwear: Extreme black thigh-high stiletto boots with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform.

Skin (everyone): Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh and muscle fold. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Background & Lighting: each painted pattern reflecting the flash in sharp specular glints, the hard light carving every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 4:5 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, all faces toward the camera.
